backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with access control plus public consultation request submission and admin-only request retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented branding/logo updates and associated frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing human‑written summaries of many frontend components, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global background/foreground vars.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry page mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component assembling landing sections and conditionally rendering the admin panel for authenticated admins.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminReque: Admin-only UI listing consultation requests with loading, error, and scrollable display states.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling auth flow, loading states, and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/landing/Benefits: Benefits section displaying six Ayurvedic weight-loss advantages in a responsive grid of cards.
frontend/src/components/landing/Consulta: Lead capture form with validation, submission via React Query, and success state handling.
frontend/src/components/landing/FAQ.tsx: Renders an FAQ section using an accordion, mapping a list of questions and answers into collapsible items.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Displays a footer with branding, social links, quick navigation buttons, and smooth scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Implements a responsive header with scroll detection, navigation links, mobile menu, and consultation/login buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Shows the hero section with marketing text, call‑to‑action buttons, decorative background, and trust indicators.
frontend/src/components/landing/ProductH: Presents highlighted products with descriptions, benefits, prices, and a featured badge, plus a consultation scroll handler.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays customer testimonials in card format with ratings, quotes, and user details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConsultationReques: Provides a mutation hook to submit consultation requests through the backend and refreshes the admin request list on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context/provider for authentication, identity loading, and login/logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and consultation requests using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and defines custom CSS variables and theming for light/dark Ayurvedic branding.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hashes, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and using plugins for typography, queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, roadmap features, requirements, and current state for the Haridwar Ayurveda landing page.
